findings.description: URL injection vulnerability via string interpolation. Transcript ID is directly interpolated into URL string without sanitization or URLComponents.
findings.recommendation: Use URLComponents instead of string interpolation: var components = URLComponents(string: "https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript"); components?.path.append("/\(id)"); guard let pollURL = components?.url else { throw TranscriptionError.invalidTranscriptID }

findings.description: URL injection vulnerability via string interpolation. Transcript ID is directly interpolated into URL string without sanitization.
findings.recommendation: Use URLComponents to construct the URL safely with proper percent encoding for the id parameter

findings.description: URL injection via string interpolation. Base URL and filename are concatenated without URLComponents.
findings.recommendation: Use URLComponents or URL.appendingPathComponent() to safely construct URLs

findings.description: API key returned as plain String from Keychain. API keys stored as String can be memory-dumped and appear in crash logs.
findings.recommendation: Implement SecureString wrapper that stores data encrypted in memory and provides explicit cleanup with clear() method

findings.description: API key property exposes plain String. The apiKey property returns String? which can remain in memory.
findings.recommendation: Replace String? with SecureString type that stores data encrypted and provides secure cleanup

findings.description: API key stored as plain String property. The apiKey is stored as String which can be extracted from memory dumps.
findings.recommendation: Use SecureString wrapper with encrypted memory storage and explicit cleanup

findings.description: Force unwrapped URL creation. URL(string:) force unwrap without validation.
findings.recommendation: Use guard let with proper error handling instead of force unwrap

findings.description: Force unwrapped URL creation for upload endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Replace force unwrap with guard let and proper error handling

findings.description: Force unwrapped URL creation for transcript endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Replace force unwrap with guard let and proper error handling

findings.description: Force unwrapped URL for API endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Use guard let or provide default URL instead of force unwrap

findings.description: Force unwrapped URL for upload endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Use guard let with proper error handling instead of force unwrap

findings.description: Force unwrapped URL for transcript endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Use guard let with proper error handling instead of force unwrap

findings.description: Defer block captures async operations which may not execute properly. Buffer cleanup in defer with Task may not complete before function exits.
findings.recommendation: Use explicit cleanup in do/catch/finally pattern instead of defer with async operations

findings.description: Weak self capture in actor-isolated context may prevent progress updates from executing.
findings.recommendation: Remove [weak self] in actor context - actors don't need weak capture for internal closures

findings.description: Manual isCancelled flag not synchronized. Using custom cancellation flag instead of Task.isCancelled.
findings.recommendation: Use Task.checkCancellation() exclusively and remove manual isCancelled flag

findings.description: Async computed property anti-pattern. isExecuting as async computed property is not idiomatic Swift.
findings.recommendation: Replace with explicit method: public func isExecuting() async -> Bool

findings.description: @unchecked Sendable without documented safety justification.
findings.recommendation: Add SAFETY comment explaining why the type is thread-safe

findings.description: @unchecked Sendable on actor is redundant. Actors are implicitly Sendable.
findings.recommendation: Remove @unchecked Sendable from actor declaration

findings.description: Error? is not Sendable. Storing Error directly breaks Swift 6 concurrency.
findings.recommendation: Create TranscriptionErrorInfo struct with String description instead of Error

findings.description: nonisolated(unsafe) without documented safety justification.
findings.recommendation: Add SAFETY comment explaining why the unsafe pattern is thread-safe in this context

findings.description: Fire-and-forget Task in init may cause race conditions. Task created in init without await.
findings.recommendation: Make init async or use proper async initialization pattern
